story.what_it_is: A toolkit from Meta that adds login, share buttons and event tracking to other apps.

marketing.name: Facebook SDK
marketing.pitch: Developer pitch: add Facebook Login, sharing and App Events to your app so you can grow and measure it.

story.for_you: You may see a Continue with Facebook button or a Share to Facebook link. Behind the scenes, the same code can tell Meta what you do in the app unless the app turns that off.
story.for_makers: Gives makers easy sign up, sharing and a way to measure which Facebook ads led to installs and purchases. Meta gets signals it uses for ad targeting and results.

use_cases.example: A mobile game offers Login with Facebook so you can find friends, and sends Meta a level reached event to improve ad targeting.
A news app adds a Share button so a story posts to your Facebook feed in two taps.
An advertiser sees that a Facebook ad click led to a purchase in the app and bids more for similar people.
A store app sends Meta an add to cart event so you see that exact product in ads later.
A dating app uses Facebook login to pull a profile photo and verify a real person.
A product team looks at Facebook Analytics style reports on who opens the app after an ad.

story.android_note: Can read the Google ad ID if the AD_ID permission is allowed.
story.ios_note: Events are limited by Apple's Ask App Not to Track choice and Meta's own aggregated reporting.

linkedin.how: Exodus lists Facebook Analytics, Facebook Login and Facebook Share code signatures in LinkedIn Android 4.1.1012 (Dec 2024 search snippet). Not confirmed that they send data.
